paragraphs.en: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
paragraphs.cn: 一年有四个季节：春、夏、秋、冬。

paragraphs.en: My favorite season is spring. The weather is warm and nice.
paragraphs.cn: 我最喜欢的季节是春天。天气温暖宜人。

paragraphs.en: Trees are green and flowers are everywhere. Birds sing in the trees.
paragraphs.cn: 树木翠绿，到处都是鲜花。鸟儿在树上歌唱。

paragraphs.en: In summer, it is hot. We can swim in the pool.
paragraphs.cn: 夏天很热。我们可以在游泳池里游泳。

paragraphs.en: In autumn, leaves turn yellow and red. It is a harvest season.
paragraphs.cn: 秋天树叶变成黄色和红色。这是一个收获的季节。

paragraphs.en: In winter, it is cold and snowy. We can make snowmen.
paragraphs.cn: 冬天又冷又下雪。我们可以堆雪人。
